quanta-computer.name: Quanta Computer
quanta-computer.description: Quanta Computer Incorporated is a Taiwanese contract manufacturer of electronic hardware. It operates in the information technology sector and is based in Taiwan.

qbe-insurance.name: QBE Insurance
qbe-insurance.description: QBE Insurance Group Limited is an Australian multinational general insurance and reinsurance company headquartered in Sydney. It offers commercial, personal, specialty, and risk management insurance products and employs around 13,500 people in 27 countries.

qinetiq.name: QinetiQ
qinetiq.description: QinetiQ is a British defence technology company headquartered in Farnborough, Hampshire. It operates in defence, security, and critical national infrastructure markets, providing testing and evaluation for air, land, sea, and target systems.

quiksilver.name: Quiksilver
quiksilver.description: Quiksilver is a surf-inspired apparel and accessories brand founded in 1969 in Torquay, Victoria, now based in Huntington Beach, California. The parent company, Boardriders, Inc., owns multiple brands including Quiksilver, Roxy, and DC Shoes, and was acquired by Authentic Brands Group in 2023.

qianjiang-motorcycle.name: Qianjiang Motorcycle
qianjiang-motorcycle.description: Qianjiang Motorcycle Group, known as QJMOTOR, is a Chinese motorcycle manufacturer founded in 1985 and headquartered in Winling, Zhejiang Province. It is one of the largest two-wheeled vehicle manufacturers in China.

qt-group-plc.name: Qt Group Plc
qt-group-plc.description: Qt Group Plc is a software company headquartered in Espoo, Finland. It was formed after Digia acquired Qt and later spun off into a separate publicly traded company.

quantum-corporation.name: Quantum Corporation
quantum-corporation.description: Quantum Corporation, headquartered in San Jose, California, provides technology for data storage, management, archiving, and protection. Its products serve enterprises, media and entertainment companies, government agencies, data companies, and life science organizations worldwide.

qnity.name: Qnity
qnity.description: Qnity Electronics, Inc. is headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, and supplies materials for semiconductor manufacturing and electronics industries. It produces products for chemical-mechanical polishing, photolithography, and OLED displays, and owns the Kapton brand.

quidel.name: Quidel
quidel.description: QuidelOrtho Corporation is an American manufacturer of diagnostic healthcare products sold worldwide. It operates in the health care industry and is based in the United States.

qx-metals.name: QX Metals
qx-metals.description: QX Metals Corp. is a Canadian multinational corporation based in Vancouver, British Columbia, focused on exploring a porphyry copper-gold deposit in Bulgaria. It was formerly known as Black Sea Copper & Gold Corp. and has a history involving geothermal power projects in the US.

quaker-chemical-corporation.name: Quaker Chemical Corporation
quaker-chemical-corporation.description: Quaker Chemical Corporation, known as Quaker Houghton, is an American chemical company headquartered in Conshohocken, Pennsylvania. It manufactures process fluids for various industrial processes and has a global presence with over half of its sales outside the U.S.

quick-heal.name: Quick Heal
quick-heal.description: Quick Heal is an Indian multinational cybersecurity software company headquartered in Pune. It develops security software for consumers, servers, cloud environments, and small to medium enterprises, with enterprise products under the brand Seqrite.

qorvo.name: Qorvo
qorvo.description: Qorvo, Inc. was an American semiconductor company headquartered in Greensboro, North Carolina. It developed and manufactured radio-frequency, analog, mixed-signal, and power-management semiconductor products for various applications including wireless communications and defense.

qumak.name: Qumak
qumak.description: Qumak S.A. is a Polish company that develops information and communications technology. It collaborates with fifty technology companies to develop products and has been listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange since August 2006.

qinghai-salt-lake-potash.name: Qinghai Salt Lake Potash
qinghai-salt-lake-potash.description: Qinghai Salt Lake Potash Company Limited is the largest potash production base in China, owning a 120-square-kilometer salt lake in Golmud, Qinghai. Established in 1997 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, it manufactures and sells potassium chloride under the brand "Yanqiao."

qcells.name: Qcells
qcells.description: Qcells is a manufacturer of photovoltaic cells headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, with engineering offices in Bitterfeld-Wolfen, Germany. Founded in 1999 in Germany, it was acquired out of bankruptcy in 2012 by the Hanwha Group. Qcells operates as a subsidiary of Hanwha Solutions.

quanjude.name: Quanjude
quanjude.description: Quanjude is a Chinese restaurant chain established in 1864 in Beijing, China. It is known for its Peking duck and longstanding culinary heritage.

qiwi.name: Qiwi
qiwi.description: QIWI plc was a Russian company offering payment and financial services in Russia and CIS countries. Its group included the QIWI payment system, QIWI Bank, CONTACT money transfer system, and other services. The company maintained representative offices in three countries.

qvc-group.name: QVC Group
qvc-group.description: QVC Group is an American media conglomerate controlled by chairman John C. Malone, who owns a majority of the voting shares.

qcr-holdings.name: QCR Holdings
qcr-holdings.description: QCR Holdings, Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Moline, Illinois. Founded in 1993, it provides commercial and consumer banking, trust, and asset management services to the Quad City and Cedar Rapids communities.

qihoo-360.name: Qihoo 360
qihoo-360.description: Qihoo 360, also known as 360 Security Technology Inc., is a Chinese internet security company based in Chaoyang, Beijing. It develops antivirus software like 360 Safeguard and 360 Mobile Safe, as well as the 360 Secure Browser and 360 Mobile Assistant app store. The company was founded in June 2005 by Zhou Hongyi and Qi Xiangdong.

quad.name: Quad
quad.description: Quad is an American marketing services company headquartered in Sussex, Wisconsin. It offers print and marketing services supporting physical and digital media, including audience targeting, media planning, creative production, retail display, postal optimization, and consumer analytics. In 2025, it was one of the largest agency companies and commercial printers in North America.

qualys.name: Qualys
qualys.description: Qualys, Inc. is a technology firm based in Foster City, California, specializing in cloud security, compliance, and related services. The company focuses on providing security solutions in the cloud computing space.

qualtrics.name: Qualtrics
qualtrics.description: Qualtrics, LLC is an American experience management company with co-headquarters in Seattle, Washington, and Provo, Utah. It was founded in 2002 by Scott M. Smith, Ryan Smith, Jared Smith, and Stuart Orgill.

quanta-services.name: Quanta Services
quanta-services.description: Quanta Services is a U.S. corporation providing infrastructure services for electric power, pipeline, industrial, and communications industries. It has acquired over 200 companies and has been involved in data center construction related to artificial intelligence power needs in the 2020s.

quest-diagnostics.name: Quest Diagnostics
quest-diagnostics.description: Quest Diagnostics Incorporated is an American clinical laboratory operating in the United States, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Brazil. It maintains collaborative agreements with hospitals and clinics worldwide and is a Fortune 500 company.

questar-corporation.name: Questar Corporation
questar-corporation.description: Questar Corporation was a natural gas public utility based in Salt Lake City, Utah. In June 2024, it was acquired by Enbridge for $4.3 billion.

quinstreet.name: QuinStreet
quinstreet.description: QuinStreet, Inc. is a publicly traded online marketing company based in Foster City, California. It generates web traffic for clients through consumer websites in media, home, and financial services sectors.

quebecor.name: Québecor
quebecor.description: Québecor Inc. is a diversified media and telecommunications company based in Montreal, Canada, serving the Quebec region. The company changed its French spelling to include an acute accent in 2012.

qlik.name: Qlik
qlik.description: Qlik is an American information technology company offering a data integration, analytics, and artificial intelligence platform. Founded in 1993 in Lund, Sweden, it is now based in King of Prussia, Pennsylvania. The company was taken private by Thoma Bravo in 2016.

quantumscape.name: QuantumScape
quantumscape.description: QuantumScape Corporation is an American company based in San Jose, California, that researches and develops solid-state rechargeable lithium metal batteries for electric cars. Founded in 2010, it employs around 850 people. Major investors include Volkswagen Group and Bill Gates.

qemetica.name: Qemetica
qemetica.description: Qemetica S.A. is a Polish chemical company headquartered in Warsaw. It is a leading producer in the European chemical industry, known for producing sodium carbonate, sodium bicarbonate, sodium silicate, and crop protection products in Poland and the EU.

quilter-plc.name: Quilter Plc
quilter-plc.description: Quilter plc is a British wealth management company formerly known as Old Mutual Wealth Management Limited. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company also has a secondary listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

quality-technology-services.name: Quality Technology Services
quality-technology-services.description: Quality Technology Services is an American provider of carrier-neutral data centers offering colocation services in North America and the Netherlands. Headquartered in Overland Park, Kansas, its largest operating areas include Northern Virginia, Dallas/Fort Worth, Chicago, and locations in Europe.

quinenco.name: Quiñenco
quinenco.description: Quiñenco S.A is a Chile-based holding company founded in 1957 by Andrónico Luksic. It invests in companies active in industrial and financial sectors and is controlled by Chile’s Grupo Luksic.

qimonda.name: Qimonda
qimonda.description: Qimonda AG was a German memory company headquartered in Munich, formed in 2006 as a spin-off from Infineon Technologies. It was the second largest DRAM company worldwide at the time and a top supplier of DRAM products for PC and server markets. The company also operated as a patent licensing firm before its patents were purchased by Micron and others.

quarto-group.name: Quarto Group
quarto-group.description: The Quarto Group is a global illustrated book publishing group founded in 1976. Although it operates globally, it is domiciled in the United States.

qwest-corporation.name: Qwest Corporation
qwest-corporation.description: Qwest Corporation, doing business as CenturyLink QC, is a Regional Bell Operating Company owned by CenturyLink. It was formerly known as Mountain States Telephone and Telegraph Company and includes operations from Malheur Bell, Northwestern Bell, and Pacific Northwest Bell.

qnb-egypt.name: QNB Egypt
qnb-egypt.description: QNB Egypt, formerly known as QNB Al Ahli until 2024, is a major Egyptian bank and a local subsidiary of the Qatar National Bank Group. It is among the largest five banks in Egypt with approximately 2 million customers.

qnb-tunisia.name: QNB Tunisia
qnb-tunisia.description: QNB Tunisia, formerly known as Tunisian Qatari Bank, is a medium-sized bank based in Tunisia. It operates as a subsidiary of the Qatari QNB Group. The bank serves the Tunisian market within the banking and fintech industry.
